enrichment.headline: Approves up to $5M with KABOOM! to build up to 20 new school playspaces through 2026
enrichment.summary: The district signs a master agreement with KABOOM!, Inc. to build up to twenty new playspaces at school sites that both sides agree on. Each playspace is capped at $250,000, and the whole agreement is capped at $5,000,000. The agreement runs from February 23, 2023 through February 22, 2026.

enrichment.headline: Pays Inspection Services up to $10,780 for materials testing at Kaiser Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: Inspection Services, Inc. of Berkeley would provide materials testing and special inspections for the Kaiser Child Development Center Outdoor Learning Environment Project. These include concrete and steel testing and anchor load tests. The limit of $10,780 includes up to $980 for additional services, and work would run from February 23, 2023 to June 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $46,783 to Applied Materials & Engineering's Castlemont High field and bleachers inspection contract
enrichment.summary: The district is adding $46,783 to its contract with Applied Materials & Engineering, Inc. of Oakland for extra inspection and testing at the Castlemont High School field and bleachers project. The added work covers several unplanned concrete pours, anchor rod testing, masonry wall coring and review of submitted documents, and includes a $4,253 contingency. The contract's total limit rises from $53,938.50 to $100,721.50, and the end date moves from February 28, 2023 to May 31, 2023, which is 92 more days.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
